# Measured field names for hook stdin payloads.
#
# SOURCE OF TRUTH: this list is transcribed field-for-field from two probe
# logs captured against a live Claude Code session (2.1.266, 2026-09-09) and
# kept outside this repo:
#   ~/WAVE_PLUGIN_ANALYSIS/probe-hooks.log
#   ~/WAVE_PLUGIN_ANALYSIS/probe2-worktree-stopblock.log
#
# Every top-level key and every `tool_input.<key>` that appears in any
# `tests/cases/**` fixture's `stdin` object MUST be present in this file.
# tests/run.sh enforces this (the fixture-key sweep, AC-405) so a fixture can
# never silently drift from what the real platform actually sends.
#
# Nested `tool_input` keys are listed dotted (`tool_input.foo`); every other
# line is a top-level key of the stdin JSON object.
#
# To add a key: capture it in a fresh probe against a real session, append
# the exact key here, and cite the probe log + date in a comment. Never add a
# key because a spec/plan/AC document mentions it in prose — spec section 2
# of docs/design/2026-09-09-hook-enforcement.md documents more fields
# (`trigger` on PreCompact) that were NOT captured in any probe below; they
# are intentionally absent here until they are actually probed, and any
# fixture using them will correctly fail the sweep until then.
#
# Task 9 (2026-09-10) probed `Read`, `Edit`, `Write` and `NotebookEdit` from
# the main session (none of the two logs above ever fired PreToolUse on a
# file-editing tool) and kept the raw output outside this repo:
#   ~/WAVE_PLUGIN_ANALYSIS/probe3-edit-write-read.log
#   ~/WAVE_PLUGIN_ANALYSIS/probe4-notebookedit.log
# The measured field is `tool_input.file_path` for Read/Edit/Write, always
# sent as an absolute path by this client — but `tool_input.notebook_path`
# for NotebookEdit, NOT `file_path`: the plan brief's assumption of one
# shared field name across all four tools does not hold on the client of
# record. `MultiEdit` was not probed — AC-270 already records it as a
# declared bound (it is not a tool this client sends at all; the matcher
# entry is forward-compatibility only), so it is exercised only via a
# synthetic fixture using the `file_path` shape, same as `Edit`/`Write`.
#
# Task 10 (2026-09-10) adds `trigger` (PreCompact), `source` (SessionStart)
# and top-level `prompt` (UserPromptSubmit). No probe log fired any of these
# three events — the controller's task-10 brief explicitly directs using the
# field names spec section 2 / section 8.6 / section 10 document instead of
# waiting on a fresh probe, since PreCompact/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit
# cannot be triggered as a side effect of a normal tool-use probe session.
# Recorded here rather than silently added so a later probe can confirm or
# correct them.
agent_id
agent_transcript_path
agent_type
background_tasks
cwd
duration_ms
hook_event_name
last_assistant_message
permission_mode
prompt
prompt_id
session_crons
session_id
source
stop_hook_active
tool_input
trigger
tool_input.command
tool_input.description
tool_input.file_path
tool_input.isolation
tool_input.model
tool_input.notebook_path
tool_input.prompt
tool_input.run_in_background
tool_input.subagent_type
tool_name
tool_response
tool_use_id
transcript_path
